body: Jonathan Merritt’s new blog is off to a great start. He reports on a startling move of Religious Right pastors to endorse John McCain this Sunday from their pulpits, calling the move “stupid” – a case of highly accurate diction, in my opinion. And he reports on the SBC-Lifeway decision to pull a magazine from their shelves that features women pastors. These are sobering reminders that the Religious Right is far from over, and their worst days may be ahead of us.
